args.content:
LANDSCAPE SYSTEMS (10 visible):
- workday.hcm: HCM - compensation agents only, NO REST API for staffing data
- sap.sf: SuccessFactors HCM - REST API: EmployeeCompensationManagement:v1 (READ payroll/compensation data)
- sap.s4: ERP - MaterialReceiptInboundAPI (INBOUND REST API for goods receipt), Procurement agents, OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine (sales opp→order)
- sap.crm: CRM - sales/marketing agents ONLY (OpportunityQualificationAdvisor, SalesCompensationOrchestrator, etc.) - NO performance analytics APIs
- sap.ehs: Safety/health - AGENTS ONLY (IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer, IncidentResponseCoordinator, ComplianceCampaignOrchestrator, etc.) - NO REST API for reading safety metrics
- sap.ariba: Procurement - PurchaseOrderNetworkAPI (REST API for PO status + vendor monitoring)
- corp.itsm: IT service mgmt - agents ONLY (NO create API)
- emarsys.cx: CX/marketing - agents only
- my.mes: Manufacturing - ProductionQualityMonitor, EquipmentOEEAnalytics (REST API for machine OEE metrics)
- siemens.plm: PLM - SupplierQualificationAndMaterialCoordinator, BOM validators, QA agents
- sap.odm: Data model (entity taxonomy only)

KEY GAPS:
- NO REST API for reading safety performance metrics in landscape (sap.ehs has only automation agents)
- NO sales performance analytics/reporting API in landscape
- NO geographic/regional dimension APIs for sales data

args.reason: The landscape contains no REST API or data product for querying safety performance metrics; sap.ehs has only automation agents for incident analysis and compliance, not data retrieval capabilities.
